Roads of the Calder Marches

Frostgate Pass is snowed in.
The Old Ford Bridge is out.
Wolfrun Trail is treacherous after dark.
Kestrel Bridge was washed away in the spring melt.
The road between Brindle and Mosswick is flooded.
Saltway is hard going in the wet months.
Greyspan has collapsed.
Thornway was cleared last week.
The path from Oakhollow to Fenwick is blocked by a rockfall.
Ravenmoor Road is closed to wagons.
Snowdrift Pass lies buried under snow.
Hollow Bridge is impassable.

Travelers say Ironpeak Pass is snowed in.
Is Coldwater Bridge out?
If Hagmire Road is flooded, we turn back.
Blackfen Bridge is not closed.
Gullet Pass was closed until spring.
A blizzard on Highcrag Pass slowed us for a day.
The road to Icewind Pass is closed.
Dunmore Bridge is out of reach of the carts.
Reedway is no more than a muddy track.
